title: Northlake Health System promotes Derek Hollis to VP of Facilities

title: Larkspur Regional Health names new CFO
summary: Larkspur Regional Health announced Renata Solis as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective September 1, 2026, succeeding the system's outgoing finance lead as part of a planned transition.
